column4: One SPL champion had a LOSING regular-season record. Who?
column9: Mike, 2019: 6–7 in the regular season, then past Drew by 0.3 in the first round (130.6–130.3), Seth, and Amit for the title.

column4: The best regular season on file is 12–1. Whose?
column9: Joe, 2013: 12–1 and the most points in the league. Al knocked him out in the semis by 3.1 (129.9–126.8). Seth won it all.

column4: Someone went 1–12 in 2009. Two years later he won the whole thing. Who?
column9: Hoos: 1–12 in 2009, SPL champion in 2011.

column4: From 2013 to 2018, how many different owners won the title?
column9: Six seasons, six champs: Seth, Glen, Matt, Rich, Amit, Drew. That's why it's called The Parity Years.

column4: Who won the very first SPL title in 2003?
column9: Glen's Fluff Muffins, 2003: three seasons before the league moved onto ESPN.

column4: 2006 draft weekend: the Mirage, Las Vegas. Skip the trip and you lost…
column9: Your 3rd-rounder. The Mirage, Aug 24–27, 2006: one of three Vegas drafts by 2008.

column4: The owners' 2008 draft survey sent draft weekend where?
column9: State College: the Penn State trip won the survey. The league came back to town for the 2023 draft.

column4: 2023 draft, back in State College at the Graduate hotel. Whose suite?
column9: Matt's suite, Sat Sep 2. Amit ran the rooms.

column4: In 2006 the SPL went to 12 teams. Which two owners joined?
column9: Mike (Bad Attitude Gang) and Pete (then the Manayunk Gunz). Everyone else goes back to 2003.

column4: Which position got kicked out of the SPL in 2020?
column9: Kickers. Constitution Appendix Two swapped the K slot for an extra Flex.

column4: The SPL left ESPN for two seasons. Which two?
column9: 2020–21 on NFL.com: the Winter Meeting picked it, then picked ESPN again for 2022. ESPN kept no scores from those years.

column4: What year did Super Flex (a QB in the OP slot) arrive?
column9: 2023: proposed and passed at the 2022 Winter Meeting.

column4: Half-point PPR came in when?
column9: 2021, the second NFL.com season: 0.5 a catch.

column4: Glen's 2012 keeper report counted every contract since day one. How many?
column9: 155 keeper contracts by 2012. The Keeper Matrix sheets only start in 2019.

column4: Who writes the annual GM Report (first one in 2011)?
column9: Glen. His 2012 edition added a Special Report on every keeper contract.

column4: Who ran the 2020 owner vote to rebuild the trophy?
column9: Mike, as the reigning champ (2019): the cup and its plaques got refreshed.

column4: BlaKK BoCCes didn't start out as BlaKK BoCCes. What was Drew's first name on ESPN?
column9: Happiest Slappies (2006), then Scrappy Chappies, then BlaKK BoCCes.

column4: The S.D. Beasters went 11–2 in 2010. Whose team was that?
column9: Seth's. S.D. Beasters became Los Beasters, then Los Beasters Big Sky.

column4: The Manayunk Gunz are known today as…
column9: Pete's Gunz dropped the Manayunk somewhere along the way.

column4: The Divisional Draft (non-champs draft their division rivals) came from whose rules?
column9: Glen and Owen wrote it; voted in at the 2020 Winter Meeting.
